create_image_processor: create a LayoutLMv2ImageProcessor instance to preprocess document images with OCR support
run_ocr_on_image: run Tesseract OCR on a document image to extract words and normalized bounding boxes
normalize_bounding_box: normalize a bounding box from pixel coordinates to LayoutLMv2's 0-1000 scale
preprocess_document_images: preprocess a batch of document images with resizing, channel flipping, and OCR extraction
configure_ocr_language: configure the OCR language and Tesseract config flags for the LayoutLMv2 image processor
